title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Guarantee Clause — Preferred Minimum Payment Floor on Revolving Statements
content:
**Clause.** On a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account, the recomputed minimum of the latest statement is worked with the preferred minimum floor, set by the guarantee and the account's age:

| A principal's personal guarantee on file | Account open | Preferred minimum floor |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | At least 36 whole months | 25.00 (long-standing floor) |
| Yes | Less than 36 whole months | 35.00 (newer-account floor) |
| No | Any | The tier's minimum payment floor: 50.00 on the Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge, 75.00 on the Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus (0.00 on the pay-in-full Commercial Account tiers) |

Whether a guarantee is on file is shown on the account record. Account age is counted in whole calendar months from the account's opening date to the payment date.

## Cases (hypothetical, Pro Revolving Charge Plus)

| Guarantee | Account open | Preferred minimum floor |
|---|---|---|
| On file | 36 months | 25.00 |
| On file | 35 months | 35.00 |
| Not on file | 120 months | 75.00 |
